s: Hetter nedarim beshabbat ubo d' seipim: mattirin nedarim beshabbat im hem letzorek hashshabbat, kegon shennadar shello leekol basar o shello lishtot yayin, o shennadar mimmalbush hatztzarik lo hayyom, vaapillu haya lo penay lehattiram qodem hashshabbat — muttar. Abal nedarim sheenam letzorek hashshabbat — en mattirim beshabbat, apillu lo haya epshar lehattiram qodem hashshabbat. Abal habbaal yakol lehaper nidre ishto apillu sheenam letzorek hashshabbat, veken haab lebitto, lepi sheim lo yaper lah "beyom shomo" — lo yukal od lahapiram:

Mi shennishba laasot melaka pelonit ad zeman peloni velo nizdammen lo laasotah ad yom haacharon shel oto zeman, veoto yom ba beshabbat vei epshar laasotah beshabbat, veyesh lo petachim lehattir nidro mishshebuato — mattirin lo apillu beshabbat, mippene sheim lo yattiru lo hayyom — i epshar lehattiro lo lemachar:

Hattarat charamim dinah kehattarat nedarim, veen mattirin ella letzorek hashshabbat. Abal nahagu lehattir cherme haqqahal apillu enam letzorek hashshabbat, lepi sheen derek lihyot kenupeya ella beshabbat, veim lo yattiruhu beshabbat — lo yitassepu beyom acher, venimtza sheen lo hetter leolam. Abal en macharimin beshabbat ki im middabar shehu letzorek shabbat, veken lemi shechillel shabbat, abal lo lemi sheabar abera acheret. Abal dabar sheyyesh bo tiqqun hammedina, veim lo yacharimu beshabbat lo yitassepu beyom acher veyigra hattiqqun — azay muttar lehacharim, kemo shemmuttar lehattir hanneder o hacherem mittaam zeh. Velaken en limchot bemah shennahagu biridim shehashshammash qore mittok hakketab mi shehu muchram al pi bet din mishshum chobotayv, mippene shetztzarik lehakriz beshabbat shemmitassepim kullam veyodeim lekuppo beiro leshallem, velule zeh hayu nipsadin hachobot vekol massa umattan. Veken mi shebbizza hechakam — yakol lenaddoto likbodo, mippene shezzehu gam ken tiqqun hammedina lehaamid hammishpat al tillo, vegam debar mitzva hu mishshum kebod hattora. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lehacharim beshabbat bedabar hannogea al hakkelal, kemo shehecherimu beshabbat et haoseqim besipre hatteba kol yemehem:
Mi shennidduhu bachalom — mattirin lo beshabbat:
